# Inflation cools, soothing investor fears. What about consumers?

The S&P 500 closed above 7,800 for the first time on Thursday, Aug. 13 — its 27th record close of 2026 — and the Russell 2000 index of smaller companies notched a high of its own.

Then the morning of Friday, Aug. 14, delivered two reminders that the American consumer isn't feeling any of it.

Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July and 3.4% from a year earlier, down from 3.5% in June, landing exactly where economists had expected.
